subject.title: feat(gateway): wire read coding tool into HTTP /tools/invoke (narrow)

question: Should OpenClaw core expose the built-in host-filesystem `read` tool through Gateway direct invocation when `gateway.tools.allow` includes `read`, `gateway.tools.directInvoke.hostFsRead` is true, and the caller is owner/admin?
rationale: Automated review can validate authorization, configuration, policy, audit, and compatibility behavior, but cannot decide whether direct authenticated host-file access belongs in OpenClaw's supported core threat model.

options.title: Accept narrow gated reads
options.body: Keep the canonical read tool behind all three gates, preserve plugin compatibility, refresh onto current main, and require exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Decline core exposure
options.body: Keep built-in host-filesystem reads unavailable through Gateway direct invocation and close or defer this proposal.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow gated reads
recommendation.body: Keep the canonical read tool behind all three gates, preserve plugin compatibility, refresh onto current main, and require exact-head proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They tightened and merged the shared `tools.invoke` contract that owns this capability surface.
